entries.description_source_en: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.
entries.fact_source_en: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
entries.description_ru: Свирепый трёхглавый дракон, нападающий на всё, что движется.
entries.fact_ru: Хайдрайгон парит в небе на шести крыльях и считает любого движущегося врагом.

entries.description_source_en: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.
entries.fact_source_en: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
entries.description_ru: Огненная личинка, которую древние люди считали посланницей солнца.
entries.fact_ru: Ларвеста выпускает пламя из пяти рогов, раскаляя его до огромной температуры.

entries.description_source_en: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it’s trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.
entries.fact_source_en: As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as “the rage of the sun.”
entries.description_ru: Огненная бабочка, осыпающая мир пылающими чешуйками.
entries.fact_ru: Древние народы называли Волкарону «яростью солнца».

entries.description_source_en: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region’s Pokémon.
entries.fact_source_en: From the moment it’s born, this Pokémon radiates the air of a leader. Its presence will calm even vicious foes.
entries.description_ru: Благородный защитник покемонов, известный по древним легендам.
entries.fact_ru: Одно присутствие Кобалиона успокаивает даже самых свирепых противников.

entries.description_source_en: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.
entries.fact_source_en: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
entries.description_ru: Легендарный воин, карающий тех, кто обижает слабых.
entries.fact_ru: Терракион способен одним ударом проломить стену огромного замка.

entries.description_source_en: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.
entries.fact_source_en: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.
entries.description_ru: Стремительный защитник природы с клинками вместо рогов.
entries.fact_ru: Вирижион сбивает врагов с толку вихревыми движениями и молниеносными ударами.

entries.description_source_en: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.
entries.fact_source_en: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
entries.description_ru: Повелитель бурь, меняющий времена года силой ветра.
entries.fact_ru: Торнадус создаёт штормы такой силы, что они способны разрушать дома.

entries.description_source_en: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
entries.fact_source_en: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
entries.description_ru: Легендарный властелин молний и гроз.
entries.fact_ru: Разряды Тандуруса не только разрушают землю, но и делают её плодороднее.

entries.description_source_en: Flames spew from its tail as it flies through the sky like a jet airplane. It’s said that this Pokémon will scorch the world.
entries.fact_source_en: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.
entries.description_ru: Белый дракон истины, рассекающий небо реактивным пламенем.
entries.fact_ru: По легенде Реширам сжигает королевства, отвернувшиеся от истины.

entries.description_source_en: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.
entries.fact_source_en: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.
entries.description_ru: Чёрный дракон идеалов, рождающий молнии вращением хвоста.
entries.fact_ru: Легенды гласят, что Зекром карает народы, утратившие праведность.

entries.description_source_en: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
entries.fact_source_en: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.
entries.description_ru: Хранитель земли, усмиряющий битвы ветра и молний.
entries.fact_ru: Ландорус насыщает почву энергией, принося богатые урожаи.

entries.description_source_en: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.
entries.fact_source_en: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
entries.description_ru: Ледяной дракон с огромной, но скованной силой.
entries.fact_ru: Курем замораживает собственное тело, чтобы удерживать свою невероятную мощь.

entries.description_source_en: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this Pokémon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training.
entries.fact_source_en: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokémon’s true power will awaken.
entries.description_ru: Юный легендарный воин, странствующий ради новых испытаний.
entries.fact_ru: Истинная сила Кельдио пробуждается лишь после тяжёлых сражений.

entries.description_source_en: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
entries.fact_source_en: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. Then it attacks.
entries.description_ru: Добрый покемон, успокаивающий окружающих своими лентообразными усиками.
entries.fact_ru: Аура Сильвеона ослабляет враждебность противников, заставляя их терять бдительность.

entries.description_source_en: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
entries.fact_source_en: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
entries.description_ru: Громогласный боец, устрашающий врагов боевой стойкой.
entries.fact_ru: Обстагун эволюционировал после бесчисленных схваток и прославился приёмом Obstruct.

entries.description_source_en: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
entries.fact_source_en: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
entries.description_ru: Воинственный кот с шерстью, похожей на железный шлем.
entries.fact_ru: После множества битв когти Перрсеркера превратились в настоящие кинжалы.

entries.description_source_en: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
entries.fact_source_en: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
entries.description_ru: Призрачный коралл, окутанный потусторонней энергией.
entries.fact_ru: Прикосновение к эктоплазме Курсолы способно обратить тело в каменную неподвижность.

entries.description_source_en: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.
entries.fact_source_en: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
entries.description_ru: Рыцарь, вооружённый луковым стеблем и листовым щитом.
entries.fact_ru: Когда его лук увядает, Сирфетчд навсегда оставляет поле боя.

entries.description_source_en: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
entries.fact_source_en: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
entries.description_ru: Искусный танцор степа с ледяной тростью.
entries.fact_ru: Мистер Райм выпускает психическую силу через узор на своём животе.

entries.description_source_en: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
entries.fact_source_en: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
entries.description_ru: Проклятая древняя фреска, ожившая благодаря духу Ямаска.
entries.fact_ru: Прикосновение к тени Рунеригуса открывает ужасные воспоминания прошлого.

entries.description_source_en: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
entries.fact_source_en: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
entries.description_ru: Мудрый олень, создающий невидимые барьеры силой загадочных чёрных сфер.
entries.fact_ru: Шерсть из бороды Вирдира отлично сохраняет тепло и ценится для зимней одежды.

entries.description_source_en: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
entries.fact_source_en: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
entries.description_ru: Свирепый покемон с каменными топорами вместо клешней.
entries.fact_ru: Кливор валит огромные деревья и защищается прочнейшим каменным панцирем.

entries.description_source_en: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
entries.fact_source_en: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
entries.description_ru: Могучий медведь, научившийся управлять торфом болот Хисуи.
entries.fact_ru: Болотистые земли придали Урсалуне её невероятную силу и выносливость.

entries.description_source_en: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
entries.fact_source_en: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
entries.description_ru: Речной дух, несущий на себе души павших сородичей.
entries.fact_ru: Баскулиджен считается сильнейшей рыбой рек региона Хисуи.

entries.description_source_en: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
entries.fact_source_en: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
entries.description_ru: Одинокий хищник с смертельным ядом и невероятной ловкостью.
entries.fact_ru: Снизлер не собирается в стаи, полагаясь только на собственную силу.
